reel_v2.sfx_fault_fixed: First render of reel v2 had every effect 8.47 s early: doorbell at 0.0 s, truck and spill sounds at 3.0 to 6.5 s under the dialogue, and silence over the truck shot. Yarin heard it; my checks had only tested the spoken lines. Cause: the doorbell was the first effect and was speed-changed in the same filter chain as its delay, which made ffmpeg drop the leading silence of the whole effects track. Fixed in assemble_reel.py (each sound is rendered alone first, then only delayed and summed) with a guard that stops the build if a track is short or starts at the wrong time. Measured after the fix with qc/audio_profile.py: doorbell 8.5 to 9.0 s, truck beeps from 11.5 s, spill 11.9 to 15.0 s, nothing before 8.25 s. Reel v1 and the 16:9 episode were measured the same way and were not affected.
